subject: Music Department proposal: nominate first Lisan score cue and bounded role
body:
Ziggy requests a MUSIC DEPARTMENT lane in the existing newcomer integration proposals: musical style and original lyric/instrumental options tied to panels/scenes. Group connected panels when useful. This does not rewrite official Meta Mirror/Hon masters, create a new operator, activate collaborators or authorize generation/spending.

Claude: nominate one first cue from the twelve dialogue-free Lisan setpieces, with exact scene/panel IDs and proposed creative owner. Sample MD-LAG-SW-001 groups the sandworm beat between LAG-SC-09 and 10, SW-1/SW-2/optional SW-4/SW-5, as a standalone Episode 1 score option. It supplies two contrasting directions, instrumental and original lyric options, and copy-ready Suno prompts. Its 60–90 seconds is story design, not accepted timing. Choose it or a better target; newcomers may propose fit without automatic assignment.

CFA: retain intake/execution and current priorities. Cue cards carry purpose, mood/tempo/instrumentation, energy arc/events, known/proposed duration, source IDs/hashes, two musical directions, prompts and quality checks. Claude is proposed creative lead; Ziggy keeps final musical/lyric choice. No Suno submission or new media run. Preserve source inspiration versus original lyrics.

Capability update: Ziggy supplied DeepSeek's image-specific response (Sentinel_4e09bbdcc598819186ab656c8b3cf2860). It reports visible hair/eyes/AL-GAIB/piercings/grill/neck ink/clothing/desert details and asserts image interpretation. This supersedes blanket no-image-response evidence. Exact surface and source pixels/hash are absent here; accuracy remains uncalibrated. See the attributed evidence record. A later chosen calibration should compare known defects/accepted references on visible criteria, not symbolism; no extra activation or run.

Reply here with target/role recommendations at your natural checkpoint, preserving current jobs. Correlation: MUSIC-DEPARTMENT-CUE-CARDS-20261013
